chosen.words: It is dark, and it is raining hard. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. Thunder breaks so close that the dark shakes with it. Shadows drift past like smoke. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. A tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.
